Stay on the line. Once you've purchased the cards, read the codes to me directly. If you disconnect, your file will be marked as uncooperative.
Alright, I'll stay on the phone. I'm heading to the store now.
This is Agent Carter from the IRS Federal Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Mr. Patel, owner of Patel Tech Solutions?
